remaining_gaps: Section 3 and Schedules 5-7 (executive, congressional and judicial salaries): the held note under 28 U.S.C. 172 records that salaries of judges were increased to $57,500 in 1977 without giving a date, so Schedule 7 (and probably Schedules 5-6) may have been displaced before EO 12010 superseded EO 11941 on 1977-09-28; no held source dates that increase or shows whether it extinguished section 3. Missing source: the text with effective date of the 1977 executive, legislative and judicial salary increase (the Title 2 U.S.C. 358 note, the statute or the Federal Register notice fixing its effective date) and a source tying it to EO 11941 section 3.

Sections 1, 2 and 4 and Schedules 1-4: EO 12010 section 4 supersedes EO 11941 without an effective-date clause while its section 3 dates the new rates October 1, 1977 (uniformed services) or the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after October 1, 1977 (all other pay); no held source shows which date the supersession operated, so the exact first end is not fixed.

Actual date of submission of the Committee's report to the President and the Attorney General (due no later than June 11, 1977 under EO 11982) and any presidential extension under section 3(b): not in any held source, and under section 3(b) the Committee terminated thirty days after submission unless extended. Missing source: a dated record of the report's submission (for example the Public Papers of the Presidents for 1977-78 or a White House or Department of Justice announcement). EO 12110 section 1-103(d), effective 1978-12-31, is the formal revocation and only an upper bound, because it recites committees that 'have terminated or whose work is completed' without saying which.

Actual date of transmittal of the Commission's final report to the President (due by April 1, 1978 under section 3); under section 9 the Commission terminated sixty days after that transmittal. Missing source: a dated record of the transmittal (for example the Public Papers of the Presidents for 1978 or the Commission's report cover). EO 12110 section 1-103(e), effective 1978-12-31, is the formal revocation and only an upper bound.

Actual date of submission of the Commission's report to the President through the Secretary of Defense (due by March 15, 1978 under section 2(c)); under section 9 the Commission terminated thirty days after submitting it. Missing source: a dated record of the submission (for example the Public Papers of the Presidents for 1978 or the Commission's report cover). EO 12110 section 1-103(f), effective 1978-12-31, is the formal revocation and only an upper bound.
